note: ark_sha256 is the digest of roots/amd-ark-genoa.der, the real ARK-Genoa from AMD KDS, verified self-signed with the ASK chaining to it. The TCB floor is the level observed on prism-node-01 (EPYC 9124, Genoa) in a signed report whose VCEK AMD issued for that exact chip. A platform below this floor is refused. A mismatch between this digest and the compiled root is a build mistake and panics at load.
